recipe.visualDefinition: A pensive man with a beard sits in the doorway of a weathered, dilapidated wooden shack. The lighting is soft and natural, emphasizing the textures of the rough-hewn timber and the dusty ground. The subject is dressed in workwear—a vest over a short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers—holding a cigarette, conveying a sense of quiet introspection. The overall tone is cool and desaturated, with a prominent blue-tinted title at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed by the dark interior of a rustic doorway
Contrast between the man's white shoes and the dark, earthy ground
Text color echoing the blue tones of the subject's clothing
Vertical lines of the wooden siding contrasting with the seated horizontal pose
coreInvariants: Centered, seated subject in a doorway

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally located, occupying the middle vertical third of the frame, seated on a raised wooden threshold.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face and hand-to-chin pose serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the blue text at the top, follows the vertical lines of the doorway down to the subject's face, and then down to the bright white shoes at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, shadowed interior of the shack provides significant negative space that makes the subject pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted browns and grays of the weathered wood and dirt.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep shadows in the doorway provide tonal depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Medium blue used for the title and echoed in the subject's shirt.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast provided by the white shoes and the dark interior.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a bearded man in his 30s sitting in the doorway of a rustic, weathered wooden shack. He is wearing a blue shirt, a tan vest, and dark pants. He is pensive, holding a cigarette. The lighting is soft daylight. The ground is dirt with some rocks. The image should have a 1970s film grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title text in the top center using a bold, blue geometric sans-serif font with tight tracking.
